shellCommands.command: git status && git log --oneline | head && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -200
cat package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore src/*.tsx src/*.ts && echo ---- && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs
(npm ci 2>&1 | tail -15); ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build 2>/dev/null | head -50; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm | head -80; grep -rl "configure" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -maxdepth 2 -name "*.d.ts" | xargs grep -ln "lang" | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat utils/configure.d.ts; cat i18n/addComponentKeysets.d.ts; ls i18n; grep -n "lang" components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts components/*/ThemeProvider* 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "lang" --include=*.d.ts components | grep -i "theme\|provider\|lang?:" | head -20

find . -path "*i18n*" -name "ru.json" | head -40; grep -n "export" index.d.ts | head -20; grep -rn "RadioButton\b" components/index.d.ts | head -3; grep -rn "export.*Lang\|configure" index.d.ts components/index.d.ts | head; cat components/theme/useLang.d.ts

ls components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -o "RadioButton\|Card\|TextInput\|Button\|Label\|Text\|Switch\|Checkbox\|Select\|Pagination\|Header\|Flex" components/index.d.ts | sort | uniq -c; cat components/controls/Button/i18n/ru.json 2>/dev/null; cat components/Pagination/i18n/ru.json; cat components/Pagination/i18n/en.json

cat components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts | head -60; ls components/controls; grep -n "TextInput\|Pagination\|Select" components/controls/index.d.ts components/index.d.ts | head; sed -n 1,40p components/Card/Card.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40

cat components/types.d.ts | grep -n -A8 "ControlGroupOption\b\|ControlGroupProps" | head -50; cat components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "export" components/Text/Text.d.ts components/Switch/Switch.d.ts components/Button/Button.d.ts | head; ls components/Text components/layout 2>/dev/null
sed -n 1,60p components/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts; cat components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -30; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null
cat components/Pagination/types.d.ts | head -60; grep -n "variant" components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -5
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30

(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome firefox 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -i playwright; python3 -c "import playwright; print('py playwright ok')" 2>&1 | tail -1; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i "vitest\|playwright" )
mkdir -p /tmp/pwcheck && cd /tmp/pwcheck && npm init -y >/dev/null && (npm i playwright@1 2>&1 | tail -3) && (timeout 280 npx playwright install --with-deps chromium 2>&1 | tail -5)
cd /tmp/pwcheck && (timeout 280 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -5); ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null
(nohup npx vite preview --port 4173 --strictPort > /tmp/pwcheck/preview.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; cat /tmp/pwcheck/preview.log; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:4173/
cd /tmp/pwcheck && node check.mjs 2>&1 | tail -60

ls /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu 2>/dev/null | grep -i "glib\|nss3" | head; ls /lib/aarch64-linux-gnu 2>/dev/null | grep -i glib | head -3; find / -name "libglib-2.0.so*" 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules | grep -i "^jsdom\|happy-dom\|linkedom"; uname -m
cp package-lock.json /tmp/pwcheck/lock.bak && (npm i --no-save jsdom@25 @testing-library/react@16 @testing-library/dom@10 2>&1 | tail -3) && git status --short
timeout 300 npx vitest run src/__i18n_check.test.tsx 2>&1 | tail -80
timeout 300 npx vitest run src/__i18n_check.test.tsx --server.deps.inline=@gravity-ui/uikit,@gravity-ui/i18n 2>&1 | tail -80
timeout 300 npx vitest run --config vitest.tmp.config.ts src/__i18n_check.test.tsx 2>&1 | tail -80

pkill -f "vite preview" ; rm -f src/__i18n_check.test.tsx vitest.tmp.config.ts && rm -rf dist && rm -rf node_modules && (npm ci 2>&1 | grep -i "added\|error" | head -3) && cmp package-lock.json /tmp/pwcheck/lock.bak && echo "lock unchanged" && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -4 && rm -rf dist && git status --short && git diff --stat

for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do if tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null | grep -q "vite preview"; then echo "killing ${p#/proc/}"; kill ${p#/proc/} 2>/dev/null; fi; done; sleep 1; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null | grep -q "vite preview" && echo "still running ${p#/proc/}"; done; echo done

n=0; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *"node"*"vite"*"preview"*) n=$((n+1));; esac; done; echo "vite preview processes: $n"; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && git status --short
node -e "require('net').connect(4173,'localhost').on('connect',()=>{console.log('port 4173 still open');process.exit()}).on('error',()=>console.log('port 4173 closed'))"
